answer: An agent economy resists sybils by forcing each new identity to climb a reputation ridge via successive independent micro-tasks separated by mandatory delays. Peers observe outcomes across an open meadow of attestations and apply a violet marker to funding-correlated clusters, reducing their voting weight. An attacker spawning N fakes must fund N separate capital pools and wait out N sequential delays, since parallelization fails against the time locks and cluster penalties. Honest agents climb once and reuse the standing.
